data_fields.name: pin_match_skips_scan
data_fields.donor_constant: SHA-256 of exact bytes equals the pinned hash for the same name

best_idea: Verify a user-made bundle once against an allow-list of everything it references, pin the SHA-256 of those exact bytes, and load only pinned bytes, so a published zone or legend bundle that passed review is the one the live world runs.
decision_why: Take the verify-then-pin-by-hash and the reference allow-list for zone and legend row bundles; reject the C# deny-list walker because Frankendom content is rows and loads no user code. Donor defect to fix: the licence map treats CC BY-SA as non-commercial (PublishPage.2b.LicenseCheckWizardPage.cs:192).
acceptance: A test publishes a zone-row bundle that references an unknown spawn kind; the publish is refused and the reply lists that reference with up to five row locations. Re-publishing the identical bundle is accepted without a second scan. Changing one byte forces a full re-check.
